reviews.author: Allen Christ
reviews.text: Honest, friendly, professional. Great place run by good people. Very fair pricing! Roberto is a true craftsman!

reviews.author: Megan Davis
reviews.text: This place is great, I would recommend to anybody. Roberto and the team were able to help with an emergency flat tire situation and gave me honest, accurate advice and help.

reviews.author: Brad Moore
reviews.text: Very informative and helpful, genuinely concerned about safety, got the product.I needed, friendly people

reviews.author: Mango Ginger
reviews.text: I was referred to this place by a friend. I needed my brake pads and rotors replaced. I called and they got me in fast. It only took about 30 mins for the job to be done. One of the mechanics also educated me on some things about my rotors and brake pads. This is a very nice and friendly place. I'd definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Francois Neufville
reviews.text: Was greeted kindly and quickly by owner wife. However she needs to give her husband lessons in being customer friendly and delivering on the back end of the business. This guy was obnoxious and rude to say the least only because i requested he put my spare on after he told me I needed to leave my wheel with him for a few hours. Never will I do business with him. He feels entitled and obviously doesnt feel the need to earn new business.

reviews.author: Kelli Williams
reviews.text: Truly grateful to Roberto for taking care of my son’s car. He had his very first flat tire and lost the lock to his custom wheel, so the AAA tow truck guy couldn’t take it off. I’m so glad I called around until I found this place. Roberto fixed that tire and took the locks off all the others too. I’m all the way in Maryland and this is my son’s first year away at college, so any mom knows how I’m feeling right now, knowing he’s safe behind the wheel of his car. Thank you Roberto! Highly recommend to everyone!

reviews.author: Da Don Dada
reviews.text: This guy overcharges for everything. Tires are marked up, service charges are marked up. Attitude is the worst, the nicest person is his wife who answers the phone. She should run it. There are too many great rim and tire shops on gate city blvd. I would say Absolute Customs is the best but there are a few others... NEVER GO HERE unless his wife takes over the business

reviews.author: troy harts
reviews.text: Affordable, quick, easy, reliable and professional. I will be using this shop for any future tire/rim related needs.

reviews.author: Larry Kincaid
reviews.text: Gave me a pretty good price on some new wheels. But they scratched the original wheels, I gave them an opportunity to make it right and all I was told it was all ready there. I drove from Thomasville to do business with them and I see how they take of thier customers. So buyers be cautious of doing business with them.

reviews.author: David Angel
reviews.text: They installed my wheels on tires they provided, installed leveling kit, tire pressure kit on all wheels and replaced the rotors and brake pads for a reasonable price. I would recommend American Custom Wheels Tires and automotive service to anyone!

reviews.author: Jamie Cuddihy
reviews.text: This is a family run operation that cares about it's customers. I have used them over the last several years for tires and plugs. I have now started to do brakes and struts work there .... they are great!

reviews.author: Taurence Jones
reviews.text: I went to get my rim fixed, it had a very small crack. Dude at front was nice and did a great job. Very fair priced.

reviews.author: Claudia F
reviews.text: Went for an estimate, it was fast , accurate and good price. Have some work done in my car and they did a great job, very knowledgeable in their business.

reviews.author: Deneen
reviews.text: I needed to get a rim repaired it had a crack in it and my tire wouldn’t hold air , they fixed my rim and I haven’t had any issues with my tire holding air at all !!! Highly recommend if you need a rim repair!!!

reviews.author: Mark Brodycz
reviews.text: The owner is always nice just one of those people you enjoy doing business with fast service great prices and quality work. A+

reviews.author: Jennifer Chavez
reviews.text: Great place! My family and I always go to them for tires, they care about their customers and are very helpful!

reviews.author: Crystal Paden
reviews.text: Rescinding which was placed due to a misunderstanding which was handled very amicably. Thank you American Custom Wheels for your great service.

reviews.author: swamppeople87
reviews.text: Took my number down never called me back regarding price for replacement part I needed. Buyer beware

reviews.author: Broadus Taylor
reviews.text: My Spot for rims and tires...If they don't got it they can Get it....and they Look out for the Cook out

reviews.author: greg gilmer
reviews.text: Wonderful people and customer service. Got me in and out with a cracked rim in an hour . Would highly recommend them.
